data: raw position polls Oct 10 to Nov 3 (25 service days, 1.54 M fresh reports on known routes, 4,355 bus-hours) + each day's timetable (route lines, listed hours) + arrivals.csv + alerts.csv + pred-updates (`experiments/routeknower/E27-scripts/offroute.py`, `offroute_rules.py`)
result: Owner: hide buses "not following their routes for a long period of time (measure this by the bus operation data and their listed hours)". Inside the listed hours buses are within 40 m of their line 90.2% of the time, 300 m 95.9%, 1 km 97.7%. 1,506 runs > 300 m off the line; classed by the bus's own arrivals: in service on both sides (mid) median 1.5 min, p90 17.6, but the Downtown Campus Connector drives 2.5 km off Lake Shore Drive for up to 32 min with riders (every DCC bus Oct 22 4-7 PM, Oct 14, Oct 15), the Apostolic bus runs to the 57th St Metra station every weekday 8 AM (920 m, 23-30 min, along another line), a Midway Metra bus spent 76 min downtown (along the DCC line). A time limit alone cannot tell those from garage runs (the Nov 2 DC-022 buses: 19-24 min). The rule: > 300 m from its line AND every other line, 15 min inside the listed hours (+-30 min) / 5 min outside, never while the line's closest points spread >= 1.5 km since the clock started (following on another street) or the bus is >= 1 km closer than its farthest point (heading back), nor inside the hours during a detour alert. It hides 835 bus-min in 25 days (109 runs: 86 going to the garage after service 643 min, 12 never serving 131, 8 leaving the garage 21.5, 1 layover 0.5, 2 parked breaks mid-service 39.1: a Red Line bus at the garage Oct 12, a DCC bus parked 1 km off at Museum Campus Oct 14); 105 of 109 at the operator's garage (41.82, -87.64); hidden within 2 min of a logged arrival 0.5 bus-min, in the 10 min before the bus served again 17.3; no moving detour or Metra run hidden. DC-022: Central hidden from 00:11, North 00:23 to its last report, East 00:27 to 00:36 (and their 830 Passio prediction rows dropped with them)
decision: **Shipped** 2026-11-04 as web `core/offroute.js` (data/live.js) + Kit `OffRoute.swift` (`LiveState.applying`), golden cases from real polls `web/tests/fixtures/offroute_golden.json` (`make_golden.py`); **replaced 2026-11-06 by E27b** (more than a block off its own line for 45 s). Without "heading back" the rule hides 932 bus-min, 66.5 of them in the 10 min before buses served again; without "following" too, 1,163 incl. 106 of buses in service on both sides (DCC detours); without "every other line" (own line only) 2,519 incl. 419 in service (the Metra runs, fill-ins)

data: the E27 per-report table rebuilt for Oct 10 to Nov 5 (27 service days, 1.70 M fresh reports, 4,809 bus-hours; `offroute.py --cache`) + arrivals.csv + alerts.csv + pred-updates; candidate rules replayed report by report (`experiments/routeknower/E27-scripts/block_rule.py`, golden `make_golden.py`)
result: Owner: "If a bus is off it's route for more than a block, make the bus disappear from the map (so it does not confuse viewers of the route) as it is most likely not running anymore--still continue to track the bus." Inside the listed hours buses are within 40 m of their own line 90.1% of the time, 100 m 93.1%, 200 m 95.1%, 300 m 96.1%; reports every 5 to 15 s; a block = 1/8 mile (201 m), lines up to about 55 m from stops, parked jitter about 16 m. Grid D 150 / 200 / 225 / 250 / 300 m x one report / 2 reports / 30 / 45 / 60 s: at 200 m / 30 s 12,878 bus-min hidden with 1,207 short hides (back within 5 min), 508 of them the Downtown Campus Connector's downtown loop near Union Station, which runs 125 to 300 m off its drawn line every lap; at 250 m / 45 s 11,394 hidden (422 a day; the E27 rule hid 959 on the same days), 535 short hides (66 at the DCC loop). By what the bus did around it: going to the garage after service 5,707, never serving 1,643, leaving the garage 914, breaks 543, in service on both sides (arrival <= 15 min before and <= 20 min after) 2,588; hidden within 2 min of a logged arrival 107, in the 10 min before its next arrival 1,517; while Passio predicted it 7,717, of which it arrived within 10 min 1,170 (15%: dropping its times is right). Single reports past 250 m: 230, none hidden at 45 s (one real spike in the golden file: DCC 12643 Nov 5 21:49, 569 m). What the E27 exemptions kept visible that this hides (10,436 bus-min): near another line 5,298 (1,929 in service on both sides: the Apostolic 8 AM Metra run every weekday, about 30 min; Apostolic/Drexel trips near the 57th St Metra station), the 15 / 5 min clock 4,201, 250 to 300 m 593, following on another street 243 (all DCC: the Lake Shore Drive detours Oct 14, 15, 22), heading back 101; the detour alert exemption kept 226 shown. By route (hidden / in service on both sides): DCC 3,027 / 670, Apostolic/Drexel 2,562 / 1,002, Red Line 1,416 / 69, South 750 / 67, East 662 / 0, Apostolic 548 / 355, North 485 / 54, Friend Center/Metra 438 / 182, Central 414 / 40, 53rd St Express 392 / 63, Midway Metra 380 / 23, Drexel 190 / 19, South Loop 79 / 36, Regents Express 53 / 9. DC-022: Central hidden from 00:01 (E27 00:11), North 00:02 (00:23), East 00:09 (00:27)
decision: **Shipped** as web `core/offroute.js` (BLOCK_M 250 m from its OWN line, CONFIRM_S 45 s on >= 2 distinct reports, only the operator detour alert exempts; data/live.js keeps the clocks and `store.away`, drops the bus and its trip updates; the route page says "1 bus is away from the route and hidden from the map.") + Kit `OffRoute.swift` (`LiveState.awayBuses`, RouteDetailView), golden real polls (every poll, 7 cases with alerts) `web/tests/fixtures/offroute_golden.json`; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md "Buses that do not follow their route".
